title: The case file: one living record of a case, every fact with its source, every change a version, readiness and options checked by code
request: The owner, after accepting the Phase 13 review: build the thin slice without stopping; 37.1 is the case file the lead agent will read and write.
spec: dclab_core.case: CaseFile v1 with the goal, decision, user, data, what the data cannot answer, limits, assumptions, unknowns, options, choice and route; facts said (quoted), computed (by code, about the data) or assumed (never counted until the person confirms); versions with who and why; readiness and the question ceiling in code; options checked (runnable, real columns, no invented number, different kinds, at most three); the problem card as a view that comes back unchanged.
plan: Read the problem card contract it must rebuild
Tests first: facts and quotes, versions, readiness and the ceiling, options, the card view
Write dclab_core/case.py, register it, generate its schema, the conformance reason, the changelog
Review, fix every finding with a test, rd-check, record, commit

decisions.decision: A said fact needs two whole words of one message, on word boundaries, sharing a content word with its value
decisions.why: the review showed a one-letter quote or a piece of a word passed, and nothing tied the quote to what it claimed

decisions.decision: Only code writes computed facts, and only about the data
decisions.why: an agent marking the goal, decision and user as computed reached readiness with nothing from the person

decisions.decision: The person's words grow only by hear(); an assumption is confirmed only by the person, in a message after it was made
decisions.why: an agent could replace the words and then quote itself, or confirm an assumption with older words

decisions.decision: The problem card's rule-made parts are kept whole in the case file; to_card changes only what the person's facts changed and closes the open fields they filled
decisions.why: the card stays the main product's contract; a round trip must be exact (checked on 12 briefs), and a correction must not leave a field both filled and open

decisions.decision: An option's kind is its tool, and each tool serves one kind of help
decisions.why: three tracks on one tool were one plan in three wordings

decisions.decision: Every version is validated whole and shares nothing with the one before
decisions.why: a copy skipped the contract's limits and shared lists, so an append rewrote history

decisions.decision: The track-brief and problem-map views wait for 37.3
decisions.why: the thin slice needs the card view now; the lead agent decides which other views it reads

change: dclab_core.case (new): CaseFile v1, CaseFact, CaseChange, CaseOption, CaseRoute, Unknown, Readiness; new, apply, hear, confirm, asked, known, readiness (ceiling six asked or two declined), check_fact, quote_ok, check_options, numbers_unsaid, from_card, to_card, views. Registered for schemas (case_file.json and its baseline), a conformance reason (the main product reads the card through to_card), CORE_INTEGRATION.md section, dclab-core 0.148.0.

findings.defect: An agent could reach readiness with facts marked computed
findings.scenario: goal, decision, user and data written as computed with 'my reading' made the case ready
findings.cause: computed allowed on every field and for every writer
findings.fix: computed only for data and what it cannot answer, and only by code

findings.defect: apply could replace the person's words
findings.scenario: words set to the agent's text, then said facts quoting it made the case ready
findings.fix: words grow only by hear(), a version by the person

findings.defect: The quote check was too loose
findings.scenario: quote 'a' or 'ales te' accepted for any value
findings.cause: any substring matched, and nothing tied quote to value
findings.fix: two whole words on word boundaries, a content word shared with the value

findings.defect: confirm accepted earlier words and any caller
findings.scenario: an assumption added after message 3 confirmed by the agent with 'the'
findings.cause: no record of when the assumption was made, no check of who confirms
findings.fix: after_words recorded; the answer must be in a later message, by the person

findings.defect: from_card brought in said facts the rules refuse
findings.scenario: a card's decision owner from answers not in the case's words counted as known
findings.cause: the card's facts were taken as said without the check
findings.fix: a failing fact enters as an assumption

findings.defect: A correction left the card inconsistent
findings.scenario: a decision given by the person stayed in open_fields; an assumed decision blanked the card's own
findings.cause: to_card overwrote fields without the open fields or the fact's status
findings.fix: filled fields leave open_fields; an assumed or rejected change keeps the card's value

findings.defect: One plan passed as three kinds
findings.scenario: prediction, advice and business options all on ml_project were kept
findings.cause: kind judged by the track and tool pair, no pairing checked
findings.fix: kind is the tool; each tool serves one track

findings.defect: Invented numbers passed and equal numbers failed
findings.scenario: '.85', '5x', '9 in 10' passed; '12%' against '12 percent' and '300.0' against '300' failed
findings.cause: the pattern missed a leading point, units and ratios, and compared raw text
findings.fix: units and ratios read, forms normalised

findings.defect: apply could store a case that cannot be read back
findings.scenario: five options stored; reading the JSON failed on the four-option limit
findings.fix: every version validated whole; unrunnable options refused

findings.defect: Words and the question counts changed without a version
findings.scenario: two declined questions made may_propose true at version 0 with no change
findings.cause: hear and asked copied the case without a change
findings.fix: both are versions (by the person, by the agent)

findings.scenario: one.words.append rewrote the earlier version's words
findings.fix: each version built from a JSON copy

findings.defect: The track-brief and problem-map views are not built
findings.scenario: the package row names them beside the card
findings.cause: the thin slice built the card view first
findings.fix: deferred to 37.3, where the lead agent reads them

measurements.name: problem card round trip
measurements.result: equal on the test's card and on 12 varied briefs the reviewer built (with and without data, answers, Persian, entity tables, text only)

outcome: The case file exists as a core contract: a model can write it only through rules that keep the person's words as the source of every known fact, every change is a version, and readiness, the question ceiling and the options' checks are code. The problem card comes back unchanged and takes the person's corrections.
lessons: A rule that a model's record must cite the person is only as strong as its quote check: test the shortest quote that should fail
A record a model writes needs every way in closed, not only the main one: the words, the counts and the copies were side doors
A view that rebuilds another contract must update every field the change touches, or the two disagree
risks: A paraphrase that shares no content word with the person's quote is refused: the agent must quote closer
The track-brief and problem-map views are not built yet
